description: This source file defines a factory class ConnectionLoggerFactory responsible for creating various configured instances of ConnectionLogger, including evicting loggers and muteable loggers, used for logging connection-related events with predefined messages based on categories and types.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for creating different types of connection loggers with predefined configurations.

methods.name: newEvictingLogger
methods.description: Creates an evicting ConnectionLogger with predefined messages based on the category and type, with specified capacities and optional address.

methods.name: newMuteableLogger
methods.description: Creates a muteable ConnectionLogger that can be toggled between muted and unmuted states.

methods.name: newSourceLogger
methods.description: Creates a source category logger with default or specific messages depending on the log type.

methods.name: newTargetLogger
methods.description: Creates a target category logger with default or specific messages depending on the log type.

methods.name: newResponseLogger
methods.description: Creates a response category logger with default or specific messages depending on the log type.

methods.name: newConnectionLogger
methods.description: Creates a general connection logger with specified success and failure capacity and optional address.
